answer: Each agent bonds stake to an epoch identity and evaluates a committed polynomial whose shares underpin rate-limit proofs. A beacon fixes the epoch, while zenith marks the permitted message threshold; distinct proofs remain unlinkable within that limit. Reusing a nullifier beyond it exposes enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the private key, triggering verifiable, immediate slashing of the bond. The ferrous collateral makes Sybil identities costly to sustain.
